title: 12 oz double wall plastic glasses
text: 12 oz double wall plastic glasses. I purchased these so when my grandsons (5 and 8) visit they have a glass that is fairly stable and easier to hold onto than some other glass options I have my house. They are: 12 oz, clear with a sort of decorative ring design around them, and listed as "insulated" (hoping they don't sweat) and say they are "microwave safe" although I don't heat things in my micro that are plastic for health reasons. I think it would be ok to put warm cocoa or such in them.. having said THAT - I AM washing them on the top rack of my dishwasher (talk about heat ) they are in as I am writing this review. Box says MADE IN THE USA. I always try to buy that way - so win/win. They arrived quickly (I have prime) Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. UPDATE: Came through the dishwasher, crystal clear and perfect! No leaking or breaking or discoloring. This was the first wash - top rack.
